subject: Startups
title: The Power Law of Returns
description: A 60-second lesson on The Power Law of Returns.

hook.text: In venture capital, the top 10% of investments generate 90% of all returns. Everything else barely matters.

buildup.text: This is the power law: a few extreme outliers dominate, while the majority of bets return little or nothing.

discovery.text: One investment in a fund—like WhatsApp or Facebook—can return the entire fund multiple times over.

twist.text: This means VCs can't play it safe. A portfolio of okay companies loses to one moonshot winner every time.

climax.text: The power law explains why VCs push for hyper-growth. Moderate success is the same as failure in their model.

punchline.text: In VC, one winner pays for all the losers combined.

quiz.question: What does the 'power law' mean in venture capital?
options: A few outlier investments generate most returns
